name: Okubo Vance Slim Bomber
description:
Okubo Vance is a Tier 3 lifestyle brand with a clean aesthetic — no logos on the outside, minimal branding on the inner label, clothes that look expensive without announcing it. The Slim Bomber is their perennial bestseller: a satin-finish nylon outer shell with ribbed knit cuffs and collar, a clean zip placket, and an interior in quilted silk-analog that feels cool against skin. It comes in a rotating seasonal palette — this season offers a muted terracotta, a pewter grey, and a deep forest green. The silhouette is fitted without being restrictive, sitting just below the hip.

It is the kind of jacket that works over a dress shirt for a late meeting or over a plain tee on the weekend. Tier 3 office workers and mid-level corp employees wear it as a statement of quiet taste. It does not have any tech features. It is simply a very good-looking bomber at a price that requires saving up or expensing.
what_it_says: You have taste and the budget to act on it. You are not trying to impress anyone in particular, which is itself a kind of impression.
worn_by: people who dress well on a considered budget
story_hooks: A character is wearing the exact same bomber in terracotta as the person they are supposed to surveil — they have to decide whether to change or lean into it
Okubo Vance quietly discontinued a colorway after one appeared in surveillance footage of a high-profile assassination; wearing that color now carries unspoken weight
An Okubo Vance bomber in mint condition, three seasons old, is found in an abandoned Tier 2 apartment — the previous tenant was clearly not Tier 2

physical_description.visual_profile: A refined, understated bomber silhouette that reads as intentionally expensive without ostentation. Clean lines, fitted proportions, sits just below the hip with a subtle taper at the waist. Projects quiet confidence and curated taste.
physical_description.fit: Slim but not restrictive; tailored through the shoulders and torso with a slight suppression at the waist. Allows full range of motion without excess fabric. Sits above the hip bone, flattering across most body types.
physical_description.primary_material: Satin-finish nylon outer shell — smooth, subtle sheen that catches light without glare. Interior quilted silk-analog for temperature regulation and comfort against skin.
physical_description.texture: Outer: smooth, almost liquid-like nylon with low friction. Ribbed knit cuffs and collar provide subtle texture contrast and grip. Interior: quilted diamond pattern with soft, cool tactile finish.
physical_description.color_scheme: Rotating seasonal palette: muted terracotta (warm, earthy), pewter grey (neutral, versatile), or deep forest green (sophisticated, understated). All colorways are desaturated and intentionally non-flashy.
physical_description.closures: Clean metal zip placket down center front, likely brushed gunmetal or matte silver. No visible branding on the slider.
distinctive_features: Ribbed knit collar and cuffs in tonal color
Satin nylon creates subtle sheen without logos
Interior quilted silk-analog visible at cuffs and collar
Clean seaming with no decorative stitching
Hip-length cut with subtle waist suppression
No tech integration or visible pockets
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 — accessible luxury. Expensive enough to require saving or corporate expense account, but priced to move among working professionals.
physical_description.cultural_context: Mid-level corpo aesthetic. Worn by office workers, mid-management, and skilled professionals who value quality and understatement over visible branding. Signals taste, stability, and comfort with one's own status.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically pristine or broken-in; creasing at elbows and shoulders develops with wear. Nylon shell resists wrinkling. Retains shape and sheen through regular wear.
